claim: Reads Recipe JSON, JSON-LD, and Markdown into editable fields
sandbox: fresh browser context; paste JSON, JSON-LD, and Markdown fixtures separately; assert title, source URL, ingredient, and step fields; edit and retain a title change for each format

claim: Every suggested repair can be undone
sandbox: fresh browser context; apply and undo each demo repair, then apply 31 separate unit repairs and undo all 31 to assert every original line is restored

claim: Exports repair-details JSON with an ISO timestamp, source attribution, and parsed ingredient fields
sandbox: demo data; apply all suggested repairs, download repair details, and assert schema, valid ISO timestamp, repaired text, parsed fields, source URL, and author

claim: Exports Schema.org Recipe JSON-LD and repaired original-format files that can be imported again
where: landing method, export format selector, README
sandbox: fresh demo; download Recipe JSON-LD and import it again; paste Markdown, export repaired original Markdown, and import it again

claim: The sample opens Rosemary tomato beans with three repairable issues
where: landing action note, README, demo page
sandbox: fresh browser context; open ?demo=1 and assert the sample title, persistent demo banner, and exactly three repairable issues

claim: No recipe text leaves your device and the repair flow makes no third-party requests
where: landing facts and privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request during the demo repair flow and assert every URL is same-origin

claim: Demo source uses a separate demo: session key and never enters real storage
sandbox: fresh browser context; mutate demo, assert localStorage is empty and only a demo-prefixed session key exists, then leave demo and assert it is removed

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; load demo, wait for service worker control, switch the browser offline, reload, and assert the sample bench is available

claim: Rejects recipe files larger than 2 MB
sandbox: fresh browser context; choose a generated 2 MB plus one byte fixture and assert the size error

claim: The full repair and export flow is free and needs no account
where: landing facts and privacy section, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; repair the demo and reach enabled export with no sign-in, purchase, or payment step

claim: Source URLs are preserved in exports and never opened
where: workbench input note, landing limits, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; repair and export the demo as JSON-LD while recording requests, then assert the source URL is retained and its origin is never requested

claim: Repairs do not change cooking instructions
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every demo instruction, apply all suggested repairs, and assert every instruction is byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: Flags malformed quantities, long units, missing data, invalid source URLs, and oversized fields
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect deterministic demo and JSON fixtures, then blank an edited title and ingredient to assert named diagnostics and disabled export

claim: Every suggested repair shows its exact before and after value
sandbox: fresh browser context; open each demo repair preview and assert its exact Before and After values
